about: Which player props your bookie offers. Bets, multis and per-game props only use these. Edit to suit: remove a stat to stop suggesting it, change players_per_game, or set milestones to false when the bookie only has one line per player (no 10+, 15+ ladder). An over X.5 alt line counts as offered when milestones is true, since it's the same bet as Sportsbet's (X+1)+ market; alt-line unders never count. Blocks added 2026-10-30 (user saw Anthony Davis 2+ blocks). Checked 2026-10-28 on ATL v MIA via The Odds API; Sportsbet adds players closer to tip. 2026-10-30 (user): Sportsbet has points, rebounds, assists, threes, blocks and steals as lines and milestones; PRA/PR/PA/RA as lines and 5-step milestones (10+, 15+...), so an alt over counts only when line+0.5 is a multiple of milestone_step.
